reasoning: Recent, state-specific general‑election polling for Montana’s 2026 U.S. Senate race consistently shows Republican Kurt Alme ahead by high single to solid double digits in multi-candidate matchups, and at least competitive or slightly ahead in the more favorable head‑to‑head scenarios for Democrats and independents.[1][2][5][8][14][15] Qualitative coverage and forecaster ratings in the last 45 days describe the race as leaning Republican, with Democratic and independent vote-splitting seen as structurally advantaging Alme, reinforcing an overall R‑lean margin.[4][6][9] I did not find any credible, recent state-specific presidential general-election polling for Montana within the last 45 days, so the current measurable margin applies to the Senate race only.
